context.process_name: Carry Vehicle Wind-Down (Bringing Partner Capital to $0)
context.objective: Document how we carry out Carry Vehicle Wind-Down (Bringing Partner Capital to $0), the controls and what needs confirmation.

turns.text: When a carry vehicle approaches wind-down we list all remaining deals, carry, holdbacks, escrow, interest, expenses, taxes, liabilities and reserve assumptions. We reconcile carry by partner and prove each partner's contributions plus income less distributions. Zero for the vehicle in total is insufficient. Each partner must be zero at final close; we cannot plug differences. Objective holdback-release criteria and the final approver's name remain open.
How do you determine when each partner’s balance is ready to be treated as zero at final close?

Repeat the carry, partner-capital and GL checks for every member. Contributions plus income minus distributions must reconcile to supported timing or unrealized items during wind-down and must equal zero at final close. Review balances by GL account, component and member. If one member is positive and another negative we stop even if the vehicle nets to zero. Resolve each item under approved authority, repeat checks, get approvals, retain the final package and hand off to GP-06 and legal/tax close.
What determines whether a holdback is ready for release?

As mentioned, the objective clawback-risk and holdback-release criteria are unconfirmed; so is the decision owner. Only an approved amount may be recorded and distributed. Record the approval and update the carry schedule. Unresolved risks or later events stay open. The GP vehicle's legal dissolution is a downstream handoff, not authorization to clear balances.
What event typically prompts the team to begin this wind-down work?

Active planning starts as the fund or vehicle approaches end of life, ideally before the last investment is realized. The work continues through remaining realizations, releases, settlements, expenses, distributions and adjustments. We draw on approved member economics from GP-01/02/03 and the approved carry and holdback position from GP-04. Legal and tax dissolution begin only after accounting close and the required approvals.
What is included in the final package you retain?

We retain the list of remaining events with dated source assumptions, member-level carry and capital reconciliations, GL balance analysis, support for any authorized adjustment and affected recipients, repeated checks showing every partner at zero, and required approvals. I cannot give an approved template, filing path, retention period or final approver from the current process.
What most often causes a carry vehicle wind-down to stop or send work back for rework?

I cannot rank causes by frequency. An unresolved holdback, liability, timing difference or nonzero member balance keeps the wind-down open. Investigate by general ledger component and member; only approved corrections to contributions or profit-and-loss allocations are allowed. Keep support and repeat every affected check. A legal or tax issue goes to the appropriate owner; we do not use a balancing entry to make the vehicle look closed.
Which role is accountable for carrying the wind-down through accounting close?

The GPFS preparer builds the inventory and reconciliations, and a GPFS reviewer checks the inventory, balances, corrections, and every partner's zero. The reviewer rejects unsupported plugs. The client can make choices only where the governing documents allow it. The process owner and final approver are not named, and the preparer cannot authorize release, a reserve, a correction or legal or tax close.
Does this wind-down approach stay the same across carry vehicles, or does the work change for particular vehicles or clients?

The approved deal-by-deal method and whole-vehicle method both appear, and member participation can vary by deal. Track that participation at the applicable level. There is also an AIV wind-down variant. I cannot identify a single named client's method from this interview. The proof still has to establish zero for every partner.
What changes in the work for the AIV wind-down variant?
